The best Salesforce consulting companies in 2026 are ManasFlow for automation-first teams, Accenture and Slalom for enterprise programs, Coastal for a Salesforce-only specialist with deep review history, and Clientell for small teams that want a fixed monthly price. The right firm depends less on certifications than on project size, the clouds you use, and who will run Salesforce after go-live.

Salesforce is flexible enough to model almost any sales process, which is also why so many implementations disappoint. Fields multiply, flows conflict, and the CRM drifts away from how your team actually sells. A good Salesforce consulting firm designs the data model around your pipeline, connects the systems that feed it, and leaves you with something admins can maintain.

This guide compares 9 Salesforce consulting firms, from global integrators to SMB specialists, on what they deliver, their stated partner standing, published pricing and public review data. Everything below was checked on each firm's own website or its G2 profile on October 21, 2026.

Disclosure: ManasFlow wrote this guide and ranks itself first. We rank ourselves first for teams whose Salesforce problem is automation: lead routing, data hygiene, integrations with outbound tools, and AI steps on top of the CRM, all built by one team. ManasFlow is not a Salesforce partner and does not hold a partner tier. If you need a partner-tiered firm for a multi-cloud rollout, Agentforce at enterprise scale, or Marketing Cloud, the firms ranked 2 to 9 fit better, and we say which below.
Best Salesforce consulting firms: a brief overview
ManasFlow: Best overall for automation-first teams: Sales Cloud setup, lead routing, CRM hygiene jobs and outbound integrations, built and maintained by one team.
Accenture: Best for global enterprises running multi-country Salesforce programs.
Slalom: Best for enterprise and upper mid-market teams investing in Data Cloud and Agentforce.
Coastal: Best for a Salesforce-only specialist with the largest G2 review base in this list.
Ad Victoriam Solutions: Best for mid-market manufacturers and retailers that need MuleSoft integration and managed services.
Sercante: Best for Marketing Cloud and Account Engagement (Pardot).
Cloud for Good: Best for nonprofits and higher education.
Cloud Giants: Best for growing B2B companies fixing CPQ and quote-to-cash.
Clientell: Best for SMBs and startups that want a published monthly price.
G2 reviews by Salesforce consulting firm

Source: G2 profile pages, checked 2026-10-21. *Accenture's count covers all of its services, not only Salesforce. Cloud for Good, Cloud Giants and Clientell had no G2 reviews; ManasFlow has no G2 profile. Review counts measure review volume, not quality.
1. ManasFlow, best overall Salesforce consulting firm for automation-first teams

ManasFlow is an AI automation agency that works on Salesforce from the revenue-operations side. We set up or clean up Sales Cloud (objects, fields, stages, permissions), build lead routing and assignment, and connect Salesforce to the tools that feed it: enrichment from Clay or Apollo, outbound from Instantly and HeyReach, forms, billing and support systems. Then we automate the upkeep, so the CRM stays accurate without a full-time admin chasing records.

Our Salesforce consulting service is built for B2B teams that already pay for Salesforce and are not getting the pipeline visibility they expected. A typical engagement includes a CRM hygiene automation: a weekly n8n job that deduplicates records, flags stalled deals, routes new leads and posts a digest to Slack.

Sales Cloud setup and cleanup: data model, stages, validation rules, permissions
Lead routing, assignment and scoring
Integrations with Clay, Apollo, Instantly, HeyReach, Slack and billing tools
Scheduled n8n automation jobs for deduplication, stalled-deal alerts and reporting
AI steps on top of the CRM, such as research summaries on new accounts

B2B teams of 5 to 200 sellers whose Salesforce data no longer matches reality
Companies connecting outbound and enrichment tools to Salesforce
Revenue operations leads who want automation instead of another admin hire

2. Accenture, best for global enterprise programs

Accenture runs Salesforce transformation across marketing, sales, service and commerce, including Agentforce, Data Cloud and industry solutions. Its Salesforce page lists 55,000+ Salesforce-skilled people and 78,000+ Salesforce certifications, and says Accenture was named Salesforce Global Partner of the Year for FY27. It also announced plans to acquire NeuraFlash to expand mid-market and agentic-AI capacity.
Accenture fits when Salesforce is one part of a wider change program that also touches ERP, data platforms and change management across countries.
Main features
Multi-cloud Salesforce delivery at global scale
Agentforce, Data Cloud and Einstein programs
Industry solutions and change management
Best for
Fortune 500 and multinational organizations with multi-country rollouts
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Scale few firms can match
Also covers ERP, data platforms and change management around Salesforce
Cons
Too heavy and costly for SMBs or single-cloud projects
Team quality varies by account and region, so meet the delivery team before signing
3. Slalom, best for Data Cloud and Agentforce programs

Slalom covers nearly every Salesforce cloud, from Sales and Service to Data Cloud, Agentforce, Marketing Cloud, MuleSoft, Tableau and industry clouds. Its Salesforce page lists 14,000+ certifications and 7,400+ projects. Slalom's newsroom reports it won Salesforce's 2027 Partner of the Year award for "Systems of Agency" and describes it as Salesforce's first strategic systems integrator partner for Data Cloud and AI.
It sits between the global integrators and the boutiques: deep bench, lighter engagements than a Big Four program.
Main features
Data Cloud and Agentforce delivery
Industry clouds for financial services, health, manufacturing and public sector
Workshops and health checks
Best for
Enterprise and upper mid-market companies investing in Data Cloud or AI agents
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Recognized for AI and Data Cloud work
Offices in 12 countries
Cons
Enterprise budgets and engagement sizes
Salesforce is one practice in a generalist consultancy
4. Coastal, best Salesforce-only specialist

Coastal (formerly Coastal Cloud) focuses only on Salesforce and adjacent platforms: strategy, data modernization, implementation and integration, Agentforce, analytics and change management across Salesforce clouds, MuleSoft, Tableau, Slack and Snowflake. Its site footer says "Partner Top Tier Since 2012", and it reports 8,400+ projects. TCS agreed to acquire Coastal in December 2025, and the site now references resources through TCS.
Coastal has the largest G2 review base in this comparison, 184 reviews at 5.0.
Main features
Salesforce-only focus across clouds
MuleSoft, Tableau and Snowflake integration
Free "Salesforce Scan" diagnostic
Best for
Mid-market and enterprise companies that want a pure Salesforce specialist
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Largest public review base here
Long track record on the platform
Cons
Ask how the TCS acquisition affects staffing and onshore or offshore mix
Not built for small, budget-capped fixes
5. Ad Victoriam Solutions, best for mid-market integration and managed services

Ad Victoriam Solutions (AdVic) delivers Salesforce consulting, implementation, MuleSoft integration, data migration and managed services. It focuses on retail, high tech, healthcare and manufacturing, and lists Agentforce, Sales, Service, Commerce, Consumer Goods, Marketing, Experience, Data Cloud and CPQ. It reports 660+ Salesforce and MuleSoft certifications and is a certified B Corp.
AdVic has 14 G2 reviews at 5.0.
Main features
MuleSoft integration with ERP and other systems
Managed services after go-live
Industry focus on manufacturing and retail
Best for
Mid-market manufacturers and retailers connecting Salesforce to ERP
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Integration and managed services under one roof
Strong G2 rating
Cons
Strongest in its four core industries
No published fixed packages
6. Sercante, best for Marketing Cloud and Account Engagement

Sercante specializes in Salesforce marketing products: Account Engagement (formerly Pardot), Marketing Cloud Engagement, Growth Edition and Personalization, plus Data Cloud, Analytics and Sales Cloud. Services include implementations, migrations, managed services, custom integrations, creative services and audits. Sercante describes itself as a Salesforce Summit Partner and reports 1,200+ projects. It has been part of Trilliad since May 2024.
Main features
Account Engagement and Marketing Cloud implementation
Migrations and account audits
Marketing ops and creative services
Best for
B2B marketing teams setting up, migrating or rescuing Salesforce marketing automation
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Deep marketing-automation focus
Combines admin work with campaign know-how
Cons
Marketing-first, so complex Service Cloud or CPQ builds are not the core
Few public reviews (3 on G2)
7. Cloud for Good, best for nonprofits and higher education

Cloud for Good implements Salesforce for nonprofits, foundations, universities, healthcare and public sector organizations. It builds its own tools for the sector, including migration and fundraising accelerators, and reports more than 3,000 implementations since 2010. Its site describes it as a Premium Salesforce Partner and a certified B Corp.
Main features
Nonprofit Cloud and Education Cloud implementation
Migrations from older nonprofit packages
Managed services and data warehousing
Best for
Nonprofits and universities moving to or expanding on Salesforce

Custom quote

Cons

8. Cloud Giants, best for CPQ and quote-to-cash

Cloud Giants is a Durham, North Carolina consultancy focused on revenue operations, customer experience and technical architecture. Its published case studies cover Salesforce CPQ for SolarWinds, Sales Cloud for HqO and Experience Cloud for PAEA. Its site shows it has been a Salesforce partner since 2014, and it offers an "Expert as a Service" model next to project work.
Main features
Salesforce CPQ and quote-to-cash
Sales Cloud and Experience Cloud
Expert-as-a-service retainers
Best for
Mid-size B2B companies whose quoting process slows deals down
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Named CPQ case studies
Flexible retainer model
Cons
Small firm with limited public review data
Not built for large multi-country rollouts
9. Clientell, best for SMBs that want a fixed monthly price

Clientell sells Salesforce admin-as-a-service, fixed-price implementations and Agentforce work, delivered by human experts using its own AI admin agent. It is the only firm here with a published monthly price: Admin-as-a-Service Essentials starts at $3,500 a month for one or two orgs, and its self-serve platform starts at $249 a month. Its site shows a Certified Salesforce Partner badge.
Main features
Admin-as-a-service on a monthly plan
Fixed-price implementations
Self-serve AI admin platform

Startups and SMBs without an in-house Salesforce admin
Pricing
